decisions.decision: All board members present supported placing a Proposition 2½ override on the ballot
decisions.quote: the moderator called for a straw poll on whether all members present supported placing an override on the ballot. all members present indicated their support. the moderator confirmed that this was unanimous among those in attendance

decisions.decision: The Chairs agreed to meet to discuss messaging around the override
decisions.quote: moderator murphy suggested that a group get together to work on messaging. a distinction was made between campaigning a nd messaging. chair menard offered that the chairs will meet to discuss the messaging

decisions.decision: Budget must be finalized by end of March or early April, with April 11, 2026 as the deadline for ballot language submission to the Town Clerk
decisions.quote: the moderator noted that the april 11th ballot language deadline effectively means the tri-board must arrive at a final number by the end of march or very early april, and encouraged the chairs to keep that constraint front of mind.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Revenues adjusted upward in investment income and motor vehicle excise tax, narrowing the balanced budget gap
budget_items.quote: revenues had been revised that same day, with investment income adjusted upward by $100,000 and motor vehicle excise tax by $75,000, meaning the balanced budget gap had narrowed somewhat

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Inflation has exceeded the 2.5% levy cap in virtually every month since approximately 2018
budget_items.quote: inflation has exceeded 2.5 % in virtually every month since approximately 2018

topics.resolution: Continued to future meetings; straw polls conducted on placing override on ballot (unanimous support) and structure (7 for single override, 5 for tiered); no final decision made
topics.quote: the moderator opened the discussion by framing the central question before the tri-board: what form a proposition 2½ override should take, and how it should be structured.
